hints.title: Prime Score Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the number of distinct prime factors for each number using an Euler sieve up to the maximum element value.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Span
hints.text: For each index i, determine the left boundary with strictly greater prime score and the right boundary with greater or equal prime score using monotonic stacks.

hints.title: Greedy Power Accumulation
hints.text: The number of subarrays where nums[i] is chosen is (i - left) * (right - i). Sort the elements by value descending and greedily apply operations using modular exponentiation.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.time: O(M log log M + n log n)
complexity.notes: Sieve prime factor computation, monotonic stack span tracking, and greedy modular exponentiation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarrays takes O(n^2) which exceeds timeout for large n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M + n) auxiliary memory for sieve and stack arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine number theory sieve, monotonic stacks for interval counting, and greedy modular arithmetic.
